scientific.integrity: The motivating full PDF was inspected at the stochastic model, noise notation, effective variance definition, positive-solution lemma, extinction theorem and quadratic-variation calculation, persistence section, and numerical examples; the model and extinction-theorem pages were visually inspected. The cited two-patch diffusion paper was checked at its explicit mutually-independent Brownian assumption, and general correlated-noise patch-population literature was inspected for covariance dependence. The bundled symbolic checker verifies the two sharp variance floors and the exact strict-gap witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding distinguishes the covariance structure printed in the stochastic model from the independent-noise covariance used in its proofs. It supplies a corrected sufficient extinction condition for the printed common-noise model but does not claim that all source theorems fail, nor does it infer which covariance was used in unavailable simulation code.

title: The printed stochastic patch model and its extinction proof use different noise correlations
